data_description.base_price_kwh: Only the trading component price. Distribution, taxes and fixed fees are not included.
data_description.reset_schedules: After configuring thresholds, a separate confirmation will remove all custom schedules and restore the bundled defaults.
data_description.configure_pricing: Opens the new price profile after schedules. Existing entities keep their meaning.
data_description.import_price_list: Opens a separate import and review. Keeps original trading price, schedules, entities and HDO settings. To configure full pricing too, complete that wizard first.

thresholds.title: Tariff classification thresholds
thresholds.description: Thresholds only classify modifiers for map colors, binary sensors and automations. They do not change any tariff schedule.

data_description.cheap_threshold: Above the super cheap threshold and at or below this value is cheap. Default: -10 %.
data_description.super_cheap_threshold: At or below this value is super cheap. Default: -50 %.
data_description.expensive_threshold: From this value up to the very expensive threshold is expensive. Default: +10 %.
data_description.very_expensive_threshold: At or above this value is very expensive. Default: +25 %.

schedules.title: Tariff schedules
schedules.description: Use comma-separated `HH:MM=price change in %` items starting at `00:00`. Add or remove an item to add or remove a band.

data_description.winter_workday_schedule: Complete schedule. The default +25 % bands start at 05:00 and 18:00. Each next start ends the previous band.
data_description.winter_offday_schedule: Complete schedule. The default weekend/holiday schedule has no +25 % band, but one can be added, for example 12:00=+25.
data_description.summer_workday_schedule: Complete schedule. The default +25 % bands start at 05:00 and 18:00. The number of bands can be changed.
data_description.summer_offday_schedule: Complete schedule. The default weekend/holiday schedule has no +25 % band, but one can be added. The last band ends at midnight.

reset_schedules.title: Restore default schedules
reset_schedules.description: This removes all four custom schedules and restores the schedules bundled with the integration. Threshold and general changes from the previous steps are kept.

data.confirm_reset: I understand and want to restore all default schedules

pricing.title: Full price and HDO source
pricing.description: Select public entities of the installed ČEZ HDO integration. Dynamic Tariff selects actual pricing; both variants are always compared. Default profile: D57d, 3×25 A, 30 January 2026 two-year promotion. Changing the rate or breaker does not fetch new prices; edit the fees in the next step.

data.pricing_enabled: Enable new price and savings sensors
data.dynamic_pricing: Use Dynamic Tariff for actual prices

data_description.annual_import_kwh: Standing fees are allocated using annual import. This estimate is not a marginal kWh price.

price_rates.title: VAT-inclusive price components
price_rates.description: Enter every amount INCLUDING VAT. Divide CZK/MWh by 1000. Dynamic modifiers change trading prices only. Default POZE is zero: the lower of capacity (zero) and consumption charges. A different price list with a nonzero POZE cap requires an effective rate and annual reconciliation.

price_list.title: Read a ČEZ price list
price_list.description: Upload a PDF OR enter its direct HTTPS PDF URL on www.cez.cz. Supports the standard ČEZ Prodej household table for ČEZ Distribuce, one price period, including 21% VAT. Maximum 5 MB and 6 pages. Scans and other layouts are rejected. Rates are reviewed before saving and apply immediately; future-effective lists are rejected.

data_description.annual_import_kwh: Required to estimate the effective POZE rate when its capacity fee is nonzero. The annual estimate is not a final bill.
